status_summary: No DHS or DOJ contract with AI companies to detect influence operations was found. An Attorney General memorandum of 2025-02-05 disbanded the FBI's Foreign Influence Task Force and limited criminal FARA charges to conduct resembling traditional espionage, and the State Department office that succeeded the Global Engagement Center was reported eliminated on 2025-04-16. A report of 2026-10-14 says CISA's election disinformation work was shut down and that CISA now calls influence operations outside its mission. The stage is diverged because the federal units that tracked foreign influence operations were closed rather than expanded or supplied with contractors.

timeline.event: An Attorney General memorandum to all Department of Justice employees disbands the FBI's Foreign Influence Task Force to free National Security Division resources and limits criminal FARA and 18 U.S.C. 951 charges to conduct resembling traditional espionage by foreign government actors.

State Department staff are told that the Counter Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference office (R/FIMI), the successor to the Global Engagement Center, is eliminated; the Secretary of State confirms the closure of the former Global Engagement Center.

title: Contract with U.S. AI firms to detect and disrupt CCP influence operations
uncertainties: The State Department closure and the CISA change rest on news reports; the date of the CISA change and of a reported reduction at the ODNI Foreign Malign Influence Center were not given in the sources read. Classified or unpublicized DHS or DOJ contracts for social media analytics, and ordinary commercial licenses, would not appear in the sources reviewed; DHS social media monitoring contracts for immigration enforcement, if any, would not target CCP influence operations and were not researched. Searches performed: three web searches (Foreign Influence Task Force; CISA and the Global Engagement Center; in review, the Attorney General memorandum) and a Federal Register API query for foreign malign influence since 2025-01-20, which returned no documents. Diverged is a judgment call: the text asks for contracting, and a reader could treat the closures as unrelated and stage this not_started. Checked systematically on 2026-10-18: Federal Register search for foreign malign influence across agencies, the Unified Agenda landing page (contracting is outside rulemaking), a congress.gov and GovInfo search with a bill status read of H.R. 7969, the Justice Department newsroom (dhs.gov blocked), and one news search found no DHS or DOJ contract with AI firms for influence-operation detection. A contract-news item returned by the search, dated 2026-08-29, reports a platform's takedown of a reportedly China-linked bot network and related FBI and Justice Department investigations, with no contract award; contract awards are not systematically searchable through these routes.
